title: Gemini Notebook Audit Logs Now Available
summary: The Google Workspace Admin Reports API now supports auditing for Gemini Notebook activities. Developers can use the `activities.list` method to retrieve these new reports.
details: The `admin.reports_v1` API's `activities.list` method has been updated to include `gemini_notebook` as a new valid value for the `applicationName` parameter. This allows developers to fetch detailed audit reports specifically for Gemini Notebook activity, providing enhanced visibility into usage and security events within this application.
